response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(a.account_id) AS cnt FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), t AS (SELECT st, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM s) AS share FROM s), v AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM t) SELECT SUM(t.cnt) AS combined_account_base, AVG(t.share) AS average_share, AVG(t.share - v.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM t, v WHERE t.share > v.avg_share
